summary.text: Curtis Stinnett, an independent pharmacist from Lindsay, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma to Kevin Hern.

paragraphs.text: Stinnett was raised in Lindsay, Oklahoma, by what he describes as middle-class parents, and graduated from Lindsay High School. He earned a graduate degree from Southwestern Oklahoma State University in 2010.
In his Ballotpedia survey he says he has worked as a community pharmacist for 15 years in nearly every part of the state, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as pharmacist.

During the campaign, he said he was running on the idea that money should not dictate the country's direction, with campaign-finance reform, including reversing Citizens United, as his first priority.
He received 1.3% of the vote to Kevin Hern's 57.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
